Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Had a recent office visit with a primary care physician in one of the study practices

right.raw_text: -  History of smoking (current  [OR] or former) in the electronic health record (EHR)

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  LDCT performed in the 12 months prior to study initiation according to EHR

right.raw_text: -  Diagnosis of lung cancer indicated in problem list in the EHR
